Name: Desert Cottontail - Sylvilagus avduboni
Habitat: Open areas, grasslands, sagebrush, scattered forrests.
Food: Summer: herbaceous plants. Winter: twigs and bark. Plantain, bluegrass, clover, goldenrod, strawberry,
willow, wheat, corn, wildrose, elm, sagebrush, rush.
Miscellaneous: Very important game and food animal in much of the U.S. May cause damage to crops and orchards when in sufficient numbers.
Name: White-tailed Jack Rabbit
Habitat: Open, grassy or sagebrush plains.
Foods: Rabbitbush, sagebrush and other plants.
Miscellaneous: May cause some crop damage.
Name: Mule Deer - Odocoileus hemionus
Habitat: Coniferous forest, desert shrubs, chapanal, grasslands.
Foods: Sagebrush, fescue, bluegrass, bromegrass, needle-
grass, wheatgrass, ricegrass, pine, snowberry,
rabbitbrush, willow, alfalfa, phlox, Russian thistle,
pussytoes, rose, clover, corn, lichen.
Miscellaneous: Important game animal.
Name: White-tailed Deer - Odocoileus virginianus
Habitat: Brushy areas, forests, river bottoms
Foods: Pine, willow, alfalfa, wheatgrass, rose, bluegrass,
snowberry, pussytoes.
Miscellaneous: Important game animal.
Name: Pronghorn, (Antelope) - Antilocapra americana
Habitat: Open praries and sagebrush plains.
Foods: Sagebrush, snowberry, wheatgrass, gramagrass,
saltbush, bromegrass, locoweed, thistle, ragweed.
Miscellaneous: Important game animal.
